data.exact_reserve_text: Change in estimates of technical provisions, including foreign exchange (1,104)
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2468 reported a prior year reserve release of GBP 1.104 million in 2022, representing a 0.35% reduction in opening gross claims outstanding. This release is attributed to favorable claims development as reflected in the change in estimates of technical provisions. The syndicate is in run-off, and a significant reinsurance to close of the 2019 year of account into Syndicate 3500 occurred, which substantially reduced the overall level of technical provisions.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The syndicate is in run-off, and the 2019 year of account was reinsured to close into Syndicate 3500. The P&L statement shows a blank figure for 'Gross premiums written', but the segmental analysis provides a breakdown summing to GBP 0.333m, which has been used for gross premiums written. The claims development table is very limited, only showing data for the 2020 underwriting year.
